title: AMD buys $2.5 billion of Anthropic stock in IPO private placement

sources.quote: (“AMD”) will purchase 30,120,481 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $2.5 billion, Broadcom Inc.

explain: Alongside Anthropic's stock-market debut, AMD agreed to buy about $2.5 billion of Anthropic's Class N shares at the IPO price, in a private placement that closes right after the offering.
